IsSplitLevel.name: IsSplitLevel
IsSplitLevel.statement:
class IsSplitLevel (P : Finset (FinPlace E)) (N : outParam ℕ) where
  star_notMem : ∀ w ∈ P, star w ∉ P
  q_eq : ∀ w ∈ P, w.q = N
  protected v_natCast : ∀ w ∈ P, v (N : LocField w) = exp (-1)
  natCast_mem_iff w : ↑N ∈ w.1 ↔ w ∈ P ∨ star w ∈ P

residueOverN.name: residueOverN
residueOverN.statement:
def residueOverN {E : Type} [Field E] [NumberField E] {P : Finset (FinPlace E)} {N : ℕ}
    (y : P → ZMod N) := adeleOfLocal P fun w ↦ (y w).val / N

residueOverNapply.name: residueOverN_apply
residueOverNapply.statement:
@[simp] lemma residueOverN_apply w : residueOverN y w = if h : w ∈ P then ((y ⟨w, h⟩).val / N :
  LocField w) else 0

idemmulresidueOverN.name: idem_mul_residueOverN
idemmulresidueOverN.statement: lemma idem_mul_residueOverN : idem P * residueOverN y = residueOverN y

diagN.name: IsSplitLevel.diagN
diagN.statement:
def diagN [Λ : IsSplitLevel P N] : GL (n ⊕ Unit) (LocProd P) :=
  diagGL (ite ·.isLeft 1 (MulEquiv.piUnits.symm fun w ↦ ite (↑w ∈ S) (.mk0 N NeZero.out) 1))

residueEquiv.name: IsSplitLevel.residueEquiv
residueEquiv.statement:
def residueEquiv (w : P) :=
  (ZMod.ringEquivOfPrime (ResField w.1) ‹Fact _›.1 (by simp [← card_ResField, ← Λ.q_eq w])).symm

reduction.name: IsSplitLevel.reduction
reduction.statement: def reduction := RingHom.pi fun w ↦ (Λ.residueEquiv w).toRingHom.comp (residueAt w)

reductioneqiff.name: IsSplitLevel.reduction_eq_iff
reductioneqiff.statement:
lemma reduction_eq_iff {x c} : Λ.reduction x = c ↔ ∀ w, v ((x.1 w - (c w).val) /
  N) ≤ 1

inclGL.name: IsSplitLevel.inclGL
inclGL.statement:
abbrev inclGL {E n : Type} [Field E] [NumberField E] {P : Finset (FinPlace E)} [Fintype n] :=
  map (n := n) (O (F := LocProd P)).subtype

liftGL.name: IsSplitLevel.liftGL
liftGL.statement:
abbrev liftGL := surjInv (GL_map_surjective (n := n) Λ.reduction fun y ↦ ⟨⟨(y · |>.val),
  fun _ _ ↦ _root_.natCast_mem ..⟩, by simp [reduction_eq_iff]⟩)

lastBasisVector.name: IsSplitLevel.lastBasisVector
lastBasisVector.statement: abbrev lastBasisVector : n ⊕ Unit → P → ZMod N := Pi.single (.inr ()) 1

existsGLlastcolandrow.name: IsSplitLevel.exists_GL_last_col_and_row
existsGLlastcolandrow.statement:
lemma exists_GL_last_col_and_row {R} [CommRing R] : ∃ k : _ → GL (n ⊕ _) R, ∀ y,
  IsUnit (y (.inr ())) → (k y).1.col (.inr
  ()) = y ∧ (k y).1.row (.inr ()) = y

fourierOp.name: IsSplitLevel.fourierOp
fourierOp.statement:
def fourierOp := π.ρ diagNInv * ∑ y with IsUnit (y (.inr ())),
  psiN (y (.inr ())) • π.ρ (inclGL (liftGL (exists_GL_last_col_and_row.choose y)))

mirabolic.name: IsSplitLevel.mirabolic
mirabolic.statement:
def mirabolic := ((stabilizer (GL (n ⊕ Unit) _) (lastBasisVector : n ⊕ _ → P → ZMod N)).comap
  Λ.reductionGL).map inclGL

ramified.name: IsSplitLevel.ramified
ramified.statement:
def ramified :=
  {φ | ∀ w, ∃ x : Oˣ, (∀ v ≠ w, Λ.reduction x v = 1) ∧ φ ∈ (1 - π.ρ (inclGL (scalar _ x))).range}

liftFn.name: IsSplitLevel.liftFn
liftFn.statement:
@[simps! -isSimp] abbrev liftFn := liftIntegralFn (m := n') (n := n) Λ.reduction

seal liftIntegralFn

lastRowDatum.name: IsSplitLevel.lastRowDatum
lastRowDatum.statement:
def lastRowDatum :=
  Λ.liftFn (n' := n' ⊕ _) (if · (.inr ()) = lastBasisVector (n := n) then 1 else 0)

lastColDatum.name: IsSplitLevel.lastColDatum
lastColDatum.statement: def lastColDatum y := Λ.liftFn fun T : Matrix n' (n ⊕ _) _ ↦ ite (Tᵀ (.inr ()) = y) 1 0

charDatum.name: IsSplitLevel.charDatum
charDatum.statement: def charDatum y := Λ.liftFn (n := n) (n' := n' ⊕ _) (psiN <| · (.inr ()) ⬝ᵥ y)

LiftLaw.name: IsSplitLevel.LiftLaw
LiftLaw.statement:
structure LiftLaw (L :
  (Matrix (n' ⊕ Unit) (n ⊕ Unit) (LocProd P) → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] π →ₗ[ℂ] π') (γ : ℂ) where
  integral_equivariant a b f φ : π'.ρ (inclGL b) (L (liftFn (f <|
    (reductionGL b).1 * · * (reductionGL a).1)) (π.ρ (inclGL a) φ)) = L (liftFn f) φ
  diagNInv_law φ : π'.ρ diagNInv (L lastRowDatum φ) =
    γ • L (lastColDatum lastBasisVector) (π.ρ diagNInv φ)

binders.name: L
binders.type: (Matrix (n' ⊕ Unit) (n ⊕ Unit) (LocProd P) → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] π →ₗ[ℂ] π'

lastColDatumnezero.statement: lemma lastColDatum_ne_zero {g} : g ∈ Λ.mirabolic (n := n) → lastColDatum lastBasisVector g.1 ≠ 0

  φ ∈ ramified π) : let C := π'.ρ Λ.diagNInv (L (charDatum lastBasisVector) φ)

    γ • L (lastColDatum lastBasisVector) (fourierOp π φ)

compUpTopairseqsmul.statement:
lemma compUpTo_pairs_eq_smul {X : ℕ → _} [∀ j, Fintype (X j)] (π : ∀ j, Rep ℂ (GL (X j ⊕ _)
  (LocProd P))) {L γ : ∀ j, _} (R : ∀ j, LiftLaw _ (π (j + 1)) (L j) (γ j)) {φ} {d : ℕ → ℂ} (h :
  φ ∈ ramified (π 0)) p : compUpTo (M := (π <| 2 * ·)) (d · • (π _).ρ diagNInv ∘ₗ ∑ y, L _
  (charDatum y) ∘ₗ L _ (lastColDatum y)) p φ = (∏ i ∈ range p, d i * #{y : X (2 * i + 1) ⊕ Unit →
  P → ZMod N | ∀ w, ∃ a, IsUnit (y a w)} • ∏ l ∈ range (2 * i + 2), γ l) • compUpTo
  (L · (lastColDatum lastBasisVector)) _ ((fourierOp _ ^ p) φ)

existssubresidueOverNmemiff.name: IsSplitLevel.exists_sub_residueOverN_mem_iff
existssubresidueOverNmemiff.statement:
lemma exists_sub_residueOverN_mem_iff z : ∃ b, ∀ y : P → ZMod N, idem P * (z - residueOverN y) ∈ Ô
  E ↔ idem P * (N * z) ∈ Ô E ∧ b = y

translateSumeqsumname.name: IsSplitLevel.translateSum_eq_sum_name
translateSumeqsumname.statement:
lemma translateSum_eq_sum_name (h' : IsSplitLevel S N) v v' :
  translateSum n n' S N m (projOnFinPart _ S v ⊗ₜ projOnFinPart _ S v') = ∑ z, h.name (lastColDatum
  z <| · * (h.diagN n S).1) v ⊗ₜ h.name (charDatum z <| (h.diagN m (P \ S)).1 * ·) v'
